title: a raid opens on the sector map and the clock waits for a click
why: His note (2026-10-18, build 30.57, in a raid): "raid should show map at the beginning of the game and player has to click to proceed into the actual raid, clock/game does not start until map is dismissed, that way player can see where relevant hotspots, etc are". Before, a raid dropped him on the ground with the clock already running and the map was one key press away with the clock still running behind it. Now every raid (DEMO and CAREER, one or two players) opens on the game sector map over a frozen world: the clock, the pillagers, the weather and the bleed all stand still (it is the same freeze as the pause, G.paused through syncPause, and in a shared raid netPauseLive is false while the map is up). A click, E, Space, Enter, Esc, Tab or M, or pad A (B and D-up shut the map and count too), starts it; the click is never a shot, and the press has to come a quarter second into the raid so the click or key that launched it cannot also dismiss it. One prompt under the map, with the key or the pad button of the last device used: or click to start / to start. With two players each state word says mf (0 running, 1 on the map, 2 pressed), the window that pressed reads waiting for p2 (or the name) and the clock starts when both have pressed, or when the other is already running; a seat that never answers is waited for 4 s, a shared raid lets go after 60 s, and the PARTY arcade, where nobody may be at the machine, closes the map by itself after 20 s. The bot sim and every older check start live raids: the fixture sets MAPFIRST.skip=1.
now: A raid opens on the sector map. Click, press E or press A to start. The clock waits for you, and for your partner.
